blocks.html: In the conflict of so many and divers reasons, and the repugnance of the conjectures and proofs, everyone can perceive that the Court was in great perplexity; but the good and almighty God, showing that He wills always to assist justice, and that so prodigious a deed should not remain hidden and unpunished, at the point when the case was about to be judged, made the true Martin Guerre appear, as by a miracle,
